(2) Social Goals:
(a) Housing
   Guaranteed priority to Randolph Citizens of rental or sales housing units or properties, as those units or properties become available.
To use a variety of relocation financial assistance to assist owner-occupants whose property is to be required to remain owner-occupants in an improved houding environment.
To encourage and assist the maximum number of home ownership opportunities for existing tenant residents.
4) To provide public housing opportunities throughout the community in small clusters, scattered sites or leased housing, rather than one or two large housing complexes in the area.
(b) Commercial
1) To assist and cooperate in the development and support of black owned and operated commercial enterprise in Randolph.
2) To encourage the development of black enterprise through the use of small business administration loans and available management training programs.
(c) Employment and Education
1) To provide the maximum number of employment opportunities to community residents within the urban renewal area.
2) To provide educational information and on the job training to community residents in the rehabilitation and redevelopment of the Randolph community.
